name: Stone Circles of Senegambia
description: Along the River Gambia, in the Gambia and central Senegal, more than 1,000 stone circles stand in the landscape, the densest concentration of such monuments anywhere in the world. The listed sites, Sine Ngayène, Wanar, Wassu and Kerbatch, hold 93 circles of tall laterite pillars, set beside burial mounds. Raised over some 1,500 years, they mark a vast sacred landscape of a well-organized society.
